· 52-week position (27.5%) + entering recovery phase from historical low price range.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0053→0.0158): continued improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $1.58): approaching upper band, with 24.26% band width indicating potential for increased volatility.

· Swing Resistance ($1.60): breakthrough to secure further upside potential.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): confirmed recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (entering uptrend after accumulation phase): entry at 1.57, stop loss at 1.48, target at 1.75.
